_comment: Hand-entered values that cannot be extracted from the game files. Not touched by bin/extract-game: check and update them by hand after each game update. See "Hand-entered data" in docs/game-mechanics.md.

school_colors._comment: Colour of each spell school in the game's menus (Color in F_GetElementInfos, BPFL_FunctionLibrary, converted from linear to sRGB). A Blueprint constant: read once from the bytecode on 2026-10-15, not extracted.

spell_cooldowns._comment: Cooldown in seconds, before any reduction (jokers, upgrades). null = unknown.
